items.title: Ships divert course mid-trip as global contest for oil heats up
items.description: Australia is stitching together a steady supply of fuel through a patchwork of relationships. But experts question how long this new chain can last.

items.title: Vance warns Iran not to 'play' US ahead of Pakistan peace talks
items.description: The centre of Islamabad has been locked down as US delegates, including JD Vance, travel to Pakistan for peace talks with Iran.

items.title: 'Sounds good to me': How Trump was sold war in Iran
items.description: Extraordinary reporting reveals how Israel made the case for regime change in Iran — and how the fallout is driving a profound shift in American opinion, amid deep uncertainty about what the war has achieved.

items.title: Israel said it targeted Hezbollah, so we went to the site of a strike
items.description: In a residential area in Beirut an entire building had been razed to the ground and a nut shop was destroyed. The locals told the ABC "there's no Hezbollah here".

items.title: Calls for cheaper homes are 'nonsense' while banking system underpinned by housing
items.description: AustralianSuper boss says housing prices unlikely to fall much, because major banks can't afford them too

items.title: Albanese's petro-diplomacy can't overcome the pain of what may lie ahead
items.description: This is not over. The hard stuff is only just beginning. And it's going to get bumpy, testing the nation's resilience and its political leadership.

items.title: Splashdown: How Artemis II comes back to Earth
items.description: Here's a breakdown of how the Orion space capsule copes with high temperatures, slows down, and what happens as it splashes down.

items.title: UK charity sues Prince Harry for defamation
items.description: Prince Harry co-founded Sentebale 20 years ago in honour of his late mother, Princess Diana, but now the organisation is suing him for defamation.

items.title: A historic week in China could shape the Xi-Trump meeting
items.description: Taiwan's opposition leader has done something for the first time in a decade, and experts say it could shape relations between Beijing, Taipei and Washington.

items.title: Commuters trapped for hours in freeway gridlock blast lack of signage
items.description: Commuters stuck queuing for up to four hours following a truck crash on the South Eastern Freeway on Thursday blast the transport department over a lack of signs warning them of the road closure ahead.

items.title: Kennedy becomes first Australian to break 10-second barrier at home
items.description: Lachlan Kennedy has scorched to a sub-10-second run in the heats of the 100 metres at the Australian Athletics Championships, and promises his best is still to come.

items.title: Deep in a Ugandan forest, chimpanzees wage a lethal 'civil war'
items.description: A decades-long study reveals hundreds of chimpanzees waging a violent and deadly conflict against their former friends in their remote forest home.

items.title: Dockers launch late fightback to pip Magpies in frantic finish
items.description: Fremantle wins its fourth match in a row after surviving a tense final few minutes against Collingwood at Adelaide Oval.

items.title: Cowboys claim thrilling Queensland derby victory with last-minute try
items.description: The North Queensland Cowboys have won a thriller at Lang Park, beating the Brisbane Broncos 35-31. Earlier, the Dragons lost their sixth-straight to start the 2026 NRL season.

items.title: 'Cosplay is not consent': The rules of dressing up for conventions
items.description: Cosplayers say their hobby has had an astronomical rise in popularity over the past decade. While the subculture promotes 'no limits' creativity, there are still strict rules.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of a classic Aussie poem, oyster recipes and Itchy and Scratchy
items.description: Every question has only two options: one is right, and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: 'A trauma you learn to manage': On losing a best friend to suicide

items.title: You have likely heard about 'K-pop'. But what about 'P-pop'?

items.title: St Kilda's Lance Collard found guilty of using homophobic slur against opponent
items.description: St Kilda forward Lance Collard has been found guilty of using a homophobic slur against an opponent, leaving his AFL career hanging in the balance.

items.title: Friends, family thank the community for helping to find missing woman

items.title: Jury hears mum accused of son's murder allegedly said he had 'no life'

items.title: Family devastated after Qld man charged with murdering girlfriend on road trip

items.title: Roads destroyed as slow-moving TC Maila batters the Pacific on its way to Qld

items.title: 'Your actions are deplorable': Man jailed over police officer head stomp
items.description: Koby Weaver is jailed over his role in what is described as a "brutal" attack which left an off-duty police officer with serious injuries.

items.title: Second midwife charged over baby's death following failed homebirth
items.description: Jordan Michaela Holland is the second midwife charged with manslaughter over the death of a baby after a failed homebirth in Newcastle.
